converting_recipes: Lead with real client work/portfolio evidence, not a generic value proposition — the buyer's real question is 'have they done this before'
Put a clear, low-friction contact/inquiry CTA above the fold — no 'service area' framing, professional services aren't geo-bound
Show real project results/case studies over any stock image when available
Surface real client testimonials near the top — trust in the specific people/team matters more than for most local trades
local_seo_patterns: One H2 per real scraped service offering, worded as a search query (e.g. 'Facebook Ad Management for Small Business')
NAP in the footer as text, not just an image, with tel: and mailto: links
LocalBusiness or ProfessionalService JSON-LD subtype matched to the business
facebook_ad_angles: Real project result/case-study snippet + 'Free instant homepage redesign, see it in 48h'
Screen-recording of the AI build happening live — the build itself is the hook
Local trust angle: 'Serving [town] since [year]' when years_in_business is a real fact
trust_signals: Real Google rating + review count from Places (never a rounded-up or invented number)
Client logos/case studies only if present in scraped facts or provided by the operator
Years in business only if stated on their existing site or provided directly
forbidden_slop: Generic handshake or stock 'team meeting' photos unrelated to the real business
Invented client names, logos, or testimonials not present in facts
Invented case-study results or metrics not present in facts
hero_video_cinematography: static wide shot of a design/creative studio, natural window light, a work-in-progress visible on screen, no readable text or logos in focus
faq_seed_questions: How long does a typical project take?
Do you work with businesses outside my area?
Can I see examples of past work?
Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
What industries do you specialize in?
How do I book a call?
